VBO:0201030.summary: Playful and attached to his person, Porter was a three-and-a-half-year-old German Shorthaired Pointer–Rottweiler cross whose owner described a love of snuggles, treats and fetch. He behaved well indoors and on lead at a distance from other dogs, but the same account reported reactive guarding around the home.
